title: A clip brought onto the timeline shows its sound waveform
goal: A recording put onto the timeline from the Library or the Finder brings its sound onto an Audio track, but that track draws a flat line instead of the shape of the sound, so you cannot aim a cut at anything in it.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-25: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/tutorial-add-a-second-clip-walk.json. After V1 is picked and b-roll.mp4 (written with sound by TutorialSampleRecording, same generator as the main clip whose waveform does draw) is placed with Add at Playhead, 3-command-inserts-sc.png and 4-where-they-meet-sc.png (a few seconds later) show the b-roll part of the Audio track as a flat line while the recording part shows its peaks. In tutorial-put-a-transition-on-a-cut-walk, where b-roll is in the document when it opens, its waveform does draw. EditorState+TimelineDrop.landTimelineFile calls SoundLibrary.loadWaveform only for a sound file (inAir.sound), never for a recording s own sound: likely the cause, unconfirmed.
acceptance: A recording added at the playhead from the Library shows the waveform of its sound on its Audio track within a second
The same holds for a recording dragged onto a track from the Finder
A walk at Next defaults photographs the Audio track after adding b-roll and checks the waveform is drawn

log.note: triage 2026-09-25 spot-check: confirmed from the picture in the notes, /tmp/photonz-playtest/tutorial-add-a-second-clip-walk/4-where-they-meet-sc.png: the Tutorial Sample stretch of the Audio track draws its waveform, and the b-roll stretch after the cut is a flat line. Moved p2 -> p1: the focus says a clip's sound is visible under its picture, and the second-clip guide shows this to every person who takes it.

Root cause confirmed: SoundLibrary.onWaveformLanded was declared but never set, so a bar drawn before its waveform was read was never redrawn. New expectWaveform step failed on tutorial-add-a-second-clip-walk (Library, Add at Playhead) and second-clip-on-the-timeline-walk (Finder drop) with 'shape HAS been read, so the bar was never told'; both pass after making SoundLibrary @Observable on its waveforms. Scripts/test.sh green (9857 tests); library-clip-onto-a-track, transition-picker-at-a-cut, tutorial-put-a-transition-on-a-cut, a-long-captioned-recording, an-editing-session walks ok. expectWaveform added to the lock-safe list by reading, not yet watched under a lock. Audit rough item (waveform look vs video-audio mock) left in the audit only: not changed by this task, no new task filed.

Added clips now draw their waveform on landing (SoundLibrary observable on waveforms, commit 9968c2d1). Verified by new expectWaveform claims in the second-clip tutorial walk (Library) and second-clip-on-the-timeline walk (Finder), failing before and passing after, at Next defaults; full test suite green.
